title: Fertilizer1155 pays out Beans (payFertilizer) inside _beforeTokenTransfer using pre-transfer balances and before the ERC1155 acceptance check
description: Fertilizer1155.safeTransferFrom calls _beforeTokenTransfer -> Fertilizer._update(from)/_update(to) -> IBS(owner()).payFertilizer(account, amount), an external Bean-paying call into Beanstalk, BEFORE _transfer updates the ERC1155 balances and before __doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck. __update reads _balances[id][account].amount, which for both from and to reflects PRE-transfer balances; that is the intended settle-before-move behavior for the sender but means recipient (to) is settled on its old (often zero) balance, and the Bean payout external call occurs while the 1155 transfer is mid-flight. This is an ERC1155-callback ordering / CEI concern more than an ERC20 non-standard-token issue, and overlaps the reentrancy specialist's lane (Fertilizer is owner-gated to Beanstalk, which has nonReentrant on its facets). No fund-loss path was traced end-to-end from the token-integration angle; flagged for the reentrancy/logic agents to confirm whether a malicious to-contract callback during __doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck can reenter while fertilizer payout state is mid-update.
impact: Potential reentrancy/ordering surface during Fertilizer transfers; no isolated token-integration fund-loss path confirmed. Cross-listed to reentrancy specialist.

ite.technique: External Bean payout in _beforeTokenTransfer prior to balance finalization and acceptance check
